crime: {WITCH_NAME} told one girl the hope she still had: her mother was outside looking for her. Afterward, whenever a monitor announcement appeared, the girl shouted, “It's your mother!” and the prisoners laughed. {WITCH_NAME} stopped speaking of hope. Everything would fail; everything would end badly.
The girl filmed herself sliding down the stair banister most evenings. {WITCH_NAME} had warned more than once that it would kill her.

That evening brought the same joke. Minutes later, {WITCH_NAME} waited at the foot of the stairs. As the girl slid toward the end, she said no to the hand reaching for the rail. The girl failed to catch it and fell headfirst onto the stone floor. Her phone kept recording beside the body.
{WITCH_NAME} claimed to have arrived with the others after the fall. But the final frames showed her already waiting below, facing the girl, her lips moving and both hands at her sides.
fields.epitaph: Her only hope became their joke; afterward, all she offered was no.
fields.epithet: A Hope Taught to Say No
execution: A bell cord hung beside the chair she was bound to. Behind her, out of sight, a spike advanced toward the back of her head. Each pull of the bell returned it to the start. She rang again and again. When the bell finally fell silent, the spike moved forward and pierced her head.

magic.name: Nullword
magic.text: She can stop an action she sees from being completed by saying no.
